d:
THE VALLEY RECALLS was the first duet collaboration between the Santoor legend Pandit Shivkumar Sharma and the Bansuri Maestro Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia after a gap of 30 years since they had recorded their platinum album with Pandit Brij Bhushan Kabra called "Call Of The Valley".
The Valley Recalls concert, released both on CD and DVD comprises of two parts - a traditional classical part based on the night Raga Bhupali and the second half a thematic presentation in three compositions, Peace, Love and Harmony, based on classical ragas.
